headline: President Biden signed an order adjusting certain federal pay rates, likely the yearly update to pay scales for federal workers.
what_it_does: This order changes certain rates of pay set by the federal government. No summary was provided, so the exact pay groups and amounts are not stated here. Orders with this title are usually issued each December to set the new year's pay scales for federal employees.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may be adjusted under the new pay scales set by this order.
